requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B product analytics). Workloads: interactive product chat (low-latency), document search + reranking (high-QPS), periodic batch summarization. Target SLOs: median chat latency <120ms eu-west; 95th <300ms for typical sessions; rerank throughput 200 qps with tail <500ms. Data residency: EU-only for customer data and logs; need KMS-managed keys; audit logs and retention controls. Failover: prefer multi-region fallback for DR but must honor data residency for primary user data. Cost profile: willing to pay premium for latency guarantees but expects guidance on batching/quantization to hit ARR targets.
poC_plan: Week 1: Deploy Hosted API in eu-west with sample traffic; capture latency percentiles, token costs, request/second. Week 2: Stress reranking pipeline + KV cache enabled; evaluate cost/throughput with different batch sizes; SE to test fallback to eu-central for overflow and capture cross-region latency. Deliverable: POC report with recommendations (model size, quantization, batching) and proposal for Dedicated capacity sizing.
